records.body:
Hi Sofia,

How's Wrenfield treating you this week? If there's a specific workflow you're trying to replicate from your old tool, I'm happy to help map it over.

Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Timber Systems!
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:c4846b83, email:93ff1852) and no tickets. No signal of engagement, so unaided activation in the remaining 8 days is unlikely though not impossible on an active Pro plan.

draft.subject: Getting your first project started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

I haven't heard back, so I wanted to check in once more. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually the easiest place to begin. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through setting up your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
